_readme: Held-out retrieval queries, DRAFT. 100 queries: 40 briefs, 30 scene-level intents, 20 paraphrases, 10 off-topic. Written from how people phrase briefs and scenes, not from skill text, but by the same assistant that built the retriever and having seen the skill ids, so some author bias remains. Labels are NOT here: run `npm run heldout -- pool`, open evals/heldout/review.html, grade the pooled candidates, save the labels, then `npm run heldout -- lock`. After the lock this file and labels.json must not change (a test fails if they do). Fields: id, query, category (saas|ecommerce|general-promo|all), scope (director|editor), kind (brief|scene|paraphrase|off_topic).
